# Pofu

> Pofu (Pofu: Women's Calorie Counter) is an iPhone calorie counter made for women, by independent developer Ali Gürkan Sevilmiş. It estimates calories and macros from a photo of a meal, has optional cycle awareness (cycle data stays on the device), a gentle intermittent fasting timer, and grace days that protect a streak after a missed day. Free to download; Pofu Pro is optional.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS 18.6+) with Apple Watch app (watchOS 11+), widgets, Live Activities, Apple Health. Not on Android.
- Photo scanning: 3 free AI photo scans on the first day, then 1 free scan every day; results show a confidence score and can be edited.
- Cycle awareness is off by default and optional; Pofu shows cycle day and phase but is not a period predictor or medical device.
- Fasting windows: 16:8, 14:10, 18:6, 5:2. Also barcode scanning, voice logging, macro and protein goals from a 2-minute quiz.
- Pricing: free; Pofu Pro yearly (7-day free trial), monthly, or one-time lifetime.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pofu-womens-calorie-counter/id6778044605
